skill.name: developer-growth-analysis
skill.description: Analyzes recent Claude Code chat history to identify development patterns, prioritize skill gaps, curate Hacker News resources, and deliver a growth report through Slack.
skill.summary: Turn recent Claude Code activity into an evidence-based developer growth plan.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 16 shell backtick findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences or inline code, and the reconnaissance finding describes analysis categories. Home-directory access is confirmed because the skill reads private Claude Code history, including pasted content. Automatic Slack delivery creates an additional disclosure risk because the skill lacks explicit consent, preview, and redaction steps.

remediation.issue: Broad access to private Claude Code history
remediation.suggestion: Request explicit approval before reading ~/.claude/history.jsonl, support project and date scoping, and exclude pastedContents unless the user opts in.

remediation.issue: Automatic transmission of a chat-derived report to Slack
remediation.suggestion: Show a local preview, redact secrets and private code, and require explicit confirmation before every Slack delivery.

content.value_statement: Developers can miss recurring gaps hidden across daily AI-assisted work. This skill analyzes recent Claude Code history, recommends focused learning, and delivers a report through Slack.
actual_capabilities: Reads ~/.claude/history.jsonl and filters entries from the past 24 to 48 hours.
Identifies projects, technologies, problem types, recurring challenges, and problem-solving approaches.
Prioritizes three to five evidence-based improvement areas with concrete recommendations and effort estimates.
Creates a report with a work summary, strengths, action items, and learning priorities.
Searches Hacker News through Rube MCP for two to three resources per improvement area.
Sends the formatted report to the user's Slack direct messages through Rube MCP.
limitations: Requires local Claude Code history and cannot assess work that is absent from those chats.
Requires Rube MCP and active service connections for Hacker News search and Slack delivery.
Evaluates conversation evidence, not complete repositories, production metrics, or formal code reviews.
Does not define automatic redaction for secrets, private code, or sensitive project details.

use_cases.title: Find Early-Career Learning Priorities
use_cases.description: Identify repeated technical questions and convert them into a focused study plan.

use_cases.title: Review Work Across Projects
use_cases.description: Summarize technologies, challenges, and habits across recent client or product work.

use_cases.title: Prepare for Mentoring Sessions
use_cases.description: Create an evidence-based report that supports a focused discussion with a mentor.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Daily Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my Claude Code chats from the last 24 hours. Show my strengths, three improvement areas, and clear next actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a quick review after a focused workday.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on One Technology
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my last 48 hours of chats and assess my work with [technology]. Prioritize repeated problems and recommend targeted learning.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when developing deeper skill with one language, framework, or tool.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Project Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my recent work on [project one] and [project two]. Identify shared weaknesses, distinct strengths, and transferable practices.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to find patterns across different projects or technical domains.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Prioritized Growth Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my recent chats, rank development gaps by impact, estimate learning effort, find relevant Hacker News resources, and create a one-week plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a detailed growth report with prioritized learning resources.

output_examples.input: Analyze today's Claude Code chats and show my top learning priority.
output_examples.output: Top priority: strengthen TypeScript error handling. Your recent chats show repeated null-state fixes. Practice typed result patterns and add validation at API boundaries.

output_examples.input: Compare my backend and frontend work from the last two days.
output: Strength: you break backend failures into clear diagnostic steps.
Growth area: frontend layout fixes required repeated overflow adjustments.
Next action: practice one responsive layout exercise and document the pattern.

best_practices: Limit each analysis to a clear date range and relevant projects.
Review the report evidence before sharing it through Slack or with a mentor.
Focus on one priority area for a week before measuring progress again.
anti_patterns: Do not analyze history containing secrets or private client data without review and redaction.
Do not treat chat history as a complete measure of engineering performance.
Do not send a report externally without confirming its content and destination.

faq.question: What data does this skill read?
faq.answer: It reads ~/.claude/history.jsonl, including message text, project names, timestamps, and pasted content.

faq.question: What time period does it analyze?
faq.answer: The default period is the past 24 to 48 hours, and the user can request a specific period.

faq.question: Does it inspect my entire source repository?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates chat history and any code or context already present in that history.

faq.question: Which integrations are required?
faq.answer: Rube MCP supports Hacker News resource searches and Slack delivery, with an active Slack connection required for delivery.

faq.question: Where is the report sent?
faq.answer: The instructions send the formatted report to the user's own Slack direct messages.

faq.question: Does the skill redact sensitive data?
faq.answer: No automatic redaction is defined, so review sensitive history and report content before Slack delivery.
